name: RSA Assessment
description: Assessment of RSA implementations for encryption and digital signatures. Covers key size evaluation, padding scheme review (PKCS#1 v1.5, OAEP, PSS), common implementation vulnerabilities (Bleichenbacher attacks, low-exponent attacks, fault attacks), and RSA key generation quality.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to RSA concepts or assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands RSA fundamentals and the role of key sizes and padding
evidence: Can explain RSA encryption and signature operations at a high level
Understands why key size matters and current minimum recommendations (2048-bit)
Can describe the difference between PKCS#1 v1.5 and OAEP padding

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies RSA configurations and basic weaknesses under supervision
evidence: Extracts RSA key sizes from certificates and protocol negotiations
Identifies use of PKCS#1 v1.5 padding in encryption contexts under guidance
Uses tools (OpenSSL, RsaCtfTool) to inspect RSA parameters
Documents RSA-related findings following lab reporting templates

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses RSA implementations and identifies padding vulnerabilities
evidence: Evaluates RSA key generation quality (entropy, prime selection)
Assesses RSA signature schemes for RSASSA-PSS vs RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 usage and verification strictness
Produces actionable findings referencing NIST SP 800-56B (key establishment), FIPS 186-5 (signatures), or equivalent standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex RSA assessment scenarios; demonstrates advanced attacks in lab
evidence: Demonstrates Bleichenbacher and ROBOT attacks against lab targets
Evaluates RSA implementations for timing side-channels
Identifies weak key generation (shared primes, low entropy) across large certificate datasets
Reviews and mentors junior staff on RSA assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines RSA assessment methodology; publishes research on RSA implementation security
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's RSA assessment methodology
Published research on RSA implementation vulnerabilities or novel factoring techniques
Provides expert consultation on RSA migration strategies (key size upgrades, algorithm transitions)
Trains teams on RSA internals, attacks, and assessment approaches

assessment_methods.description: Assess an RSA deployment: evaluate key sizes, padding schemes, and implementation quality; demonstrate a Bleichenbacher attack on a vulnerable lab target
Review RSA assessment findings from a recent engagement for completeness and technical accuracy
